format: CORE. Video structure: simulated-video-call | talk-to-camera | mirror-selfie | skit-dialogue | slice-of-life | app-demo | montage
presenter_attire: CORE. western-casual | ethnic-saree | ethnic-kurta-salwar | professional-formal | sleepwear-homewear | none
presenter_skin_tone: CORE. Casting attribute on Monk Skin Tone bands: light | medium-light | medium | medium-deep | deep | unclear | none. Neutral descriptor only.
presenter_hair: CORE. long-open | long-tied | short | braided | covered | none
setting: CORE. bedroom | kitchen | living-room | office | classroom | outdoor | vehicle | plain-studio | multiple | unclear
language_spoken: CORE. Language actually spoken in audio (hindi, tamil, telugu, kannada, malayalam, ...). ALWAYS split by this before comparing creatives — auction prices differ per language.
subtitle_script: CORE. How captions are written: native-script | romanized | english | mixed | none
hook: CORE. Attention device of the first 3s: question-to-viewer | bold-claim | emotional-moment | activity-in-progress | incoming-call | direct-greeting | curiosity-tease | other
ai_content_label: CORE. yes | no — a visible 'AI Generated Content' tag
ad_objective_type: CORE. Which side of the marketplace the ad recruits: user-acquisition (talk to people) | host-recruitment (earn money by taking calls) | unclear. Different funnels — split by this first.
address_mode: CORE. How the presenter relates to the viewer: first-person-invitation ('call me') | app-endorsement (describes the app) | testimonial-experience | dramatized-scene
scene_description: CORE. 2-4 sentence factual description of the video. Read it, never group by it.
value_prop: MULTI-VALUE. Each distinct selling point, concrete phrase (e.g. 'no phone number needed', 'chat in your own language'). One creative can carry several.
persona_archetype: OPTIONAL. Identifiable role the presenter plays: housewife | college-student | working-professional | ... Absent when no role is established.
app_ui_shown: MULTI-VALUE. App interface elements visible: call-interface-chrome | encrypted-badge | app-screenshot | install-button | app-logo | ...
subtitle_style: OPTIONAL. Caption design as colour + shape, e.g. 'yellow highlight bar'
cta: MULTI-VALUE. Each call to action: install now | download the app | ... Timing is in _observations evidence.
emotional_register: MULTI-VALUE (max 2). Dominant tone: playful | reassuring | sincere | energetic | confident | flirtatious | melancholic-then-relieved
emotional_driver: MULTI-VALUE (max 2). Viewer need addressed: loneliness-companionship | boredom-timepass | homesickness-expat | stress-relief-unburdening | flirtation-romance | social-anxiety-ease | income-need
social_proof: OPTIONAL. Exact user-count / rating / popularity claim
offer: OPTIONAL. An actual incentive (free coins, free trial). Affordability comparisons are price_metaphor, not offer.
price_metaphor: OPTIONAL. Colloquial cheapness comparison for the app's cost, e.g. 'price of one egg', 'a packet of pickle'. Localised per language.
device_targeting_signal: OPTIONAL. Explicit device reference ('do you have an iPhone')
_observations: PAYLOAD, not an attribute. Array of {facet, value, evidence, source} — verbatim quotes with timing. Use via `view` to cite evidence. Never group by it.
_timeline: PAYLOAD, not an attribute. {duration, beats:[{t0,t1,role,says,says_en,text,text_en,shows}]} — the video's beat-by-beat structure. Join beat positions against video_p25/p50/p75/p100 to see what plays when viewers leave.
